mapper.insert: INSERT user_account (username, password_hash, name, birth, email) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, #{birth}, #{email})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, username, password_hash as passwordHash, name, birth, email, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM user_account
SELECT user_id AS userId, username, password_hash as passwordHash, name, birth, email, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM user_account WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT user_id AS userId, username, password_hash as passwordHash, name, birth, email, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM user_account WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_account SET username = #{username}, birth = #{birth}, email =#{email}, password_hash = #{passwordHash} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
